title: Flight Shade / Window seat recommendations
introduction: A Vue 3 web service for finding a window seat to avoid sunlight or enjoy a sunrise or sunset. Enter the departure and arrival airports, date and time to calculate the sun’s direction along the flight path and get a left or right seat recommendation.
myWorks: Built a single-page route form, map, seat recommendation and sharing flow with Vue 3, Vite, JavaScript and SCSS
Implemented airport code and city search with date and time inputs based on the departure airport’s local time zone
Used SunCalc and a great-circle route to calculate sunlight ratios and sunrise / sunset times, recommending window seats by preference
Displayed the flight path and sun direction with Leaflet / OpenStreetMap and built a playable flight timeline
Created a responsive interface with a fixed desktop input panel and a draggable mobile bottom sheet
Added automatic input updates, Korean / English switching and URL sharing that restores the flight and seat preference
Added keyboard airport search, focus management, reduced motion, localized prerendering, SEO and GitHub Pages deployment
achievements: Connected airport selection, seat recommendations, flight simulation and result sharing in one page
Handled airport search and solar calculations in the browser without API keys or a separate server
Made the same flight results available to view and share in Korean / English across desktop and mobile
points: Seat recommendations and a timeline for shade, sunlight, sunrise and sunset preferences
Responsive map and recommendation UI with a desktop input panel and mobile bottom sheet
Referenced FlightSide’s UI and experience, following Planearby’s Vue and SCSS structure
